items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So there was Freddie Green, Lonnie Simmons, Frank Clarke, Bobby Moore, who was the little trumpet player who played, "Out the Window," with Basie, remember?

ctx.x: With no mother. So an uncle put us away in a place called the Coleman Industrial Home, where there were some excellent musicians. I was really -- I couldn't believe it. And the teacher, Mr. Moore, he was capable of playing all the instruments. And then I became interested in music again because I loved him so much.
Well, how wonderful. What age did you become interested again?
